Maya Yoshida’s first-half header put the west coasters ahead in the first half in Texas before Erik Thommy delivered a sweetly curled finish to seal the deal after the break: ET phones it home 👽🏹 pic.twitter.com/ubOj9IQhCO— LA Galaxy (@LAGalaxy) April 11, 2026 Toluca, on the other hand, was disappointed to drop two valuable points at home to an Atletico San Luis side that doesn’t look like it will make the Liga MX Clausura playoffs over the weekend. The Red Devils were not that long ago flying high at the top of the table but have dropped down to fifth following a run of four domestic games without a win. That loss of form wasn’t apparent at the Estadio Nemesio Diez last week, though the Galaxy will hope to turn in a more dominant performance in front of their own fans. The only previous fixture between these teams played on US soil came last November in the 2025 Campeones Cup, where Toluca managed a dramatic 3-2 win over the hosts at this same ground. The Galaxy had victory in sight before two goals in the final 10 minutes slipped the result on its head, instilling a sense of unfinished business in the Americans as they return home this week.
